forensic_gap_audit_reconciliation.reconciliation_summary: Reconciliation following PR #5714 rejection and subsequent execution of REPARTITION-PLAN-002 child batches CB01-CB10. The original rejection was due to 86 test suites still importing main.py while the inventory self-reported only 5 migrated. REPARTITION-PLAN-002 partitioned the residual 86 files into 10 dispatchable child batches. Across batches CB01-CB10, test suites were systematically decoupled from the main composition root, resulting in progressive ceiling reductions from 86 -> 73 (CB01) -> 66 (CB04) -> 30 (CB07) -> 24 (CB10) -> 11 (CB06). The live AST scan on dev tip (8025bd83a) confirms exactly 11 non-whitelisted main importers, matching the enforced ceiling of 11, with 0 test files mutating sys.path in migrated suites and 0 monkeypatching read_store in migrated suites.
